# Client RPC methods that have no wiremock test.
#
# This is a ratchet baseline, not a target. .github/scripts/rpc-mock-coverage.sh
# fails when a client RPC call appears that is NOT listed here, so adding an API
# obliges you to mock it. Entries are removed as mocks are written; the file is
# meant to shrink and eventually disappear.
#
# Everything listed here is exercised only by the nightly Studio suite, which
# means a break shows up hours later against a commit range instead of in the
# pull request that caused it.
#
# Before mocking one, check the server's actual request and response shape:
#
#   .github/scripts/rpc-mock-coverage.sh --dve-database ~/Software/Studio/dve-database
#
# Generated 2026-08-07 from the state at that commit; edit by hand thereafter.
